title: Operator Station (direct human-attended Telex endpoint)
summary: Direct Station reset PR #136 is responding to review at head 59043ce5bf6b3fdd2bb7084777d15141929fbf41. CI is green; three node-scoped contract blockers and five clarifications are assigned for repair.

nodes.title: Vertical spike: mediated human-attention loop
nodes.summary: Historical evidence node: proved a Windows human-attended Station, durable notification/reply loop, provenance, restart, and delivery/ack health. Its operator-agent topology remains non-normative evidence.

nodes.title: Human-attended Station interaction is worth productionizing
nodes.summary: Completed builder gate: the desktop inbox/notification/reply experience proved valuable. The later product reset keeps that viability evidence while rejecting prescribed mediation as product scope.

nodes.title: Initial production Station and operator-loop contract
nodes.summary: Historical completed contract in issue #114/PR #116. Its direct Station findings remain evidence; mediation/operator-agent requirements are subject to ADR 0051 and the direct Station contract reset.

nodes.title: Direct Station product contract reset
nodes.summary: Rewrite the normative Operator Station design around direct human-attended address operation, add ADR 0051, narrow ADRs 0047/0048, preserve mediation only as external non-normative evidence, and produce an implementation-ready station-app handoff.

nodes.title: Direct Station product direction accepted
nodes.summary: Builder accepts the direct human-attended Station contract, ADR 0051 supersession boundary, external-only mediation disposition, Application Client dependency, and downstream implementation geometry before station-app starts.

nodes.title: Production Windows Operator Station
nodes.summary: Implement the separately installable Windows desktop Station under the accepted direct contract: configured attended addresses, actionable feed and threads, local notifications, ordinary reply and exact-recipient disposition, backend selection, provenance, health, restart/backfill, inert rendering, safe links, and evidence-preserving cleanup.

nodes.title: Direct human-attended Station is usable
nodes.summary: Builder validates direct agent-to-Station messaging, notification usefulness, thread/reply/disposition clarity, source identity, health, restart continuity, and optionality before operational hardening proceeds.

nodes.title: Postgres, recovery, notification, security, and packaging hardening
nodes.summary: Harden the direct Station through credentialed Postgres and remote senders; restart/offline and unoccupied-address behavior; duplicate/delayed delivery; notification pressure and OS suppression; sender/provenance presentation; safe links; install/upgrade/auto-start/signing; diagnostics, cleanup, and troubleshooting.

nodes.title: Direct Operator Station validated and workstream reconciled
nodes.summary: Builder runs the hardened direct Station with real local and remote agents, confirms recovery and notification posture, reviews hardening evidence, dispositions closeout observations, and accepts the exported Station contract.

checkpoints.title: Human-attended Station interaction proven valuable
checkpoints.summary: Historical spike and dogfood proved that a desktop Telex inbox, notifications, and durable reply path are worth productionizing.

checkpoints.title: Direct Station contract accepted
checkpoints.summary: The normative direct-attendance contract and ADR 0051 are accepted, mediation is external-only, and station-app has a stable design/dependency handoff.

checkpoints.title: Direct Station usable
checkpoints.summary: The supported desktop Station works through the conformant Application Client and has passed builder usability validation.

checkpoints.title: Operator Station operationally validated
checkpoints.summary: The direct human-attended endpoint has survived Postgres, restart/offline, notification-pressure, provenance, safety, packaging, and cleanup validation.
